objective: Prove or refute that across-span is bounded in terms of the number of observed distinctions, uniformly over all along-counts. Use time-sparse observations, finite-state paths, and extension on a finite across interval; check boundary consistency and an all-width separation argument.
status: Proved for arbitrary finite bond supports on base 16. A fixed support size bounds across-span independently of all along-counts. The exact rate remains open.
title: A uniform bound on the across-span of every fixed-size bond
